channel.title: Sample campaign advisories — FICTIONAL DEMO FIXTURE (not CISA data)

item.title: DEMO-AA26-158A: Ransomware Actors Exploiting Unpatched Edge Devices for Initial Access (sample)
item.description: Sample (fictional) campaign advisory: ransomware affiliates are exploiting unpatched VPN and firewall appliances (including DEMO-2026-0102) for initial access, then escalating privileges and disabling backups before encryption. Includes indicators and mitigations.

item.title: DEMO-AA26-152A: State-Sponsored Actors Pre-Positioning in Critical Infrastructure OT Networks (sample)
item.description: Sample (fictional) campaign advisory: state-sponsored cyber actors maintain persistent access to industrial control systems via living-off-the-land techniques, targeting engineering workstations and unencrypted OT protocols for lateral movement.
